subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The patch now matches the requested technical shape, but deciding that active model-call stalls may use idle-timeout fallback while side-effecting tool stalls may not is a session-state replay policy choice.

options.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as supported recovery behavior.

options.title: Require broader recovery proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until broader runtime proof covers more model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run fallback paths against latest main.

options.title: Pause for recovery timing
options.body: Hold this PR if the adjacent cron recovery-timing work should settle before deciding downstream abort classification.

recommendation.title: Accept phase-aware boundary
recommendation.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as supported recovery behavior.
